about: A short dreamlike cave-adventure. You start at the bottom of an endless stair, told to seek a silver-haired man when you are worthy. You explore a junction with a sword stuck in a rock, a barren area, a shadowy land and a stormy underground ocean. A hooded swordsman stalks the shadows.

done.why: I had poked at most of the nearby area and thrown the sword away. Nothing further seemed to be happening, so I left.

moments.note: The parser rejected a polite, oddly phrased request to the stair.
A hooded figure appeared, and the sword from the junction teleported into my hand, glowing.
The figure vanished when I went back, so I could not give it the sword or fight it.
Throwing the sword into the ocean worked at once and 'lost forever' with no warning.

wished: Talk to or fight the hooded figure.
Find out how the sword reached my hand.

lines.line: From nowhere, the sword from the junction appears in your hand, wildly glowing!
lines.why: The strangest event of the session, and it made the hooded figure feel like a real threat.

lines.line: you would have to swim the gap, and you have seen the surf. Not today.
lines.why: A refusal that fits the world and carries some character.

fun.why: A few good moments, but a lot of the parser said no to me.

engagement.why: The hooded figure hooked me, then vanished.

difficulty.why: I could not tell what to try, and I never found out whether the figure was a danger.

interestingness.why: The dream opening, the stalking figure and the teleporting sword are intriguing.

prose.why: Evocative room descriptions and a few distinctive refusals.
